# ghost/apodroid

Read NASA picture-of-the-day title, date and explanation in APODroid with wallpaper writes denied

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/apodroid
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/apodroid open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/apodroid read_picture --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/apodroid read_explanation --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/apodroid hide_explanation --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open APODroid with wallpaper writes and background execution denied
- `read_picture`: Read the displayed NASA picture title and date
- `read_explanation`: Expand and read the native astronomer explanation
- `hide_explanation`: Collapse the explanation without image or wallpaper controls
